decisions.reason: A flanged dismantling joint is a standard valve-installation component that sits close to the firm's core pipeline fittings offer, so keeping it costs little and fits customer demand from utilities.
The ceiling and floor pipe bracket builds on the firm's fabrication strengths, has its own product page, and serves the plant builders and contractors it already supplies.
The pipe support bracket complements the firm's pipeline component range, is presented prominently, and matches its strategy of broadening the product range in a growing industry.
